pr.title: gh-143547: Fix PyErr_FormatUnraisable() fallback
pr.body:
Hold a strong reference to 'hook' while calling the default unraisable took to log hook failure.

Fix test_sys.UnraisableHookTest: use the right decorator function to disable colors. Previously, tests were always skipped.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+Fix :func:`sys.unraisablehook` when the hook raises an exception and changes
+:func:`sys.unraisablehook`: hold a strong reference to the old hook. Patch
+by Victor Stinner.
